scope: Species, profession, prestige and progression coverage only. Faction, proficiency, familiarity and motivation remain SGC-03C.
source_basis_note: The frozen SGC inputs preserve Character-learning/progression references but do not supply missing per-record Species, profession, Prestige or progression facts. Current canonical CAB evidence is used only to prove exact acquisition/progression ownership; absent source eligibility, prerequisites, identity, tier or acquisition facts remain explicit source gaps.

evidence.specific_scope: CAB-09 explicitly governs Species/innate eligibility and acquisition, distinguishes automatic biological grants from Species-qualified selections and mixed dataset membership, and requires explicit bridges for cross-Species acquisition.

CAB22-P2-006 requires the mixed Species/Innate source surface to separate automatic biology grants, Species-qualified selections, learned/cultural/mystical/technical content and non-Species Elementalist rows without guessing biology from labels or dataset membership.

CAB-09 explicitly governs profession/crafting progression acquisition and preserves Skills, tools, facilities, ingredients, practice, research and prior-technique requirements rather than allowing XP to bypass them.

Prestige entry is a governed advanced acquisition event: explicit prerequisites/eligibility, legitimate Tier-3 entry, CAB access transaction or governed substitute, separate first Prestige Ability acquisition, and no invented T1/T2 back-pay.

CAB is completed_verified and governs the five-tier developmental-depth model, progression access, prerequisites, acquisition eligibility, XP affordability separation, Prestige Tier-3 entry and progression-specific requirements.

CAB-22 preserves unresolved prerequisite graphs, acquisition semantics, tier-access anomalies, advanced-start provenance, duplicate identity tuples and source-boundary defects for evidence-based repair; no missing node, prerequisite or tier is invented.

source_gap_preservation: Species dataset membership, labels or biological-sounding names do not prove automatic biology or grant status.
Profession/crafting XP never substitutes for Skills, tools, facilities, ingredients, practice, research or other owning requirements.
Prestige may begin at Tier 3 only under explicit entry requirements and governed access semantics; no T1/T2 filler or back-pay is invented.
Missing progression prerequisites, acquisition modes, tier intent or source identities remain CAB-22 repair items.
No new Species, profession, Prestige or progression ledger is created.
